metadata.description: Claude Code mods by R. Woeltjes

plugins.name: prompt-polaroid
plugins.description: CodeSnap-style Polaroid snapshots of your Claude Code prompts: /polaroid

plugins.name: claude-dj
plugins.description: Control YouTube Music, Spotify or anything playing: a now-playing band, a /music pane with cover art and progress, /play /pause /next /prev /vol, Spotify search, play, queue and like, and music tools for Claude

plugins.name: claude-pets
plugins.description: VS Code Pets for Claude Code: pets above your prompt that wander, chase balls, cheer when a turn ends and nap when you're away: /pet

plugins.name: coding-pet
plugins.description: A Tamagotchi-style coding companion: it earns XP from edits, reads, passing tests and commits, levels up and evolves, and needs feeding, play and rest. /codepet

plugins.name: mods-panel
plugins.description: A side panel listing your installed mods and their commands: pick a command to run it, or to fill the prompt when it takes arguments. /mods
